AND  B) ISSUE A WRIT OF MANDAMUS DIRECTING THE RESPONDENTS TO PAY THE RENT OR DAMAGES FROM THE DATE OF  -6-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:7342  WP No. 102821 of 2024 UTILIZATION TILL PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION FOR HAVING UTILIZED THE PORTION OF THE LANDS WITHOUT ACQUISITION AND WITHOUT PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION AND ETC.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners, learned HCGP for the State/respondents.

2. This petition is filed by the landlosers seeking for a writ of mandamus for a direction to respondent No.7 to initiate the acquisition proceedings consequently acquire the land in accordance with law for having already taken the land and utilized the land of the petitioners, pay the compensation to the petitioners as per the provisions of right to fair compensation and transparency in land acquisition, rehabilitation and resettlement Act of 2013 or in the alternative to pay the rent for damages for having utilized the land of the petitioners without acquisition.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: This is a case of petitioners who are owners of the agricultural lands that they were using and cultivating the land for their livelihood.

The respondents intended to form road and they started marking the portion of the land for which the petitioners objected and requested them to acquire the land in respect of the portions for which it is required for utilization NC: 2024:KHC-D:7342 of the road and only thereafter to initiate utilization or using of the land.

The respondents being the state, though assured that the land will be acquired and compensation will be paid as it is required for formation of the road which is for the larger public interest and purpose, convinced the petitioners that the compensation would be paid by the government in due course.

But however, despite the utilization of the land and road having been formed, no acquisition proceedings have taken place yet and neither any award passed or deposited with regard to utilization and formation of the road Dttatreya S/O Devaji Patil vs State Of Karnataka on 3 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36277304/
6 belonging to the land of the petitioners.

sentences.text: It is stated by the petitioners that in all 36 survey numbers,
road is formed, but none of the petitioners have been awarded compensation or no acquisition proceedings are initiated.

3. This being the state of affairs, on the representations made by the petitioners, respondent No.7 forwarded the communication to respondent No.4 to furnish the information about the acquisition process or payment of compensation.
Respondent No.4 forwarded the same to respondent No.5 to submit regarding utilization of the land for formation of the road.

However, despite all these efforts,
NC: 2024:KHC-D:7342 no communication has been sent with regard to the payment of compensation to the petitioners for having utilized their land for formation of the road.

It is also submitted that the Tahasildar forwarded a communication to the Executive Officer, Taluk Panchayat, to verify whether the lands are utilized for the PMGSY (Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana) scheme or 'Namma Grama, Namma Raste' (my land my road) scheme.

The executive officer on such communication from the Tahasildar has confirmed that the land is not utilized under the above said scheme, which was forwarded by the Tahasildar to the ADLR to verify as to any acquisition proceedings were initiated, to which the ADLR confirmed that there are no acquisition proceedings initiated with regard to the lands of the petitioners.

4. Pursuant to the information received from the Tahasildar and other officers, respondent No.7 forwarded a communication to the Tahasildar informing that if the proposal for acquisition is submitted to the office of respondent No.6 and if direction is issued, they would prepare the process for acquisition of the land of the NC: 2024:KHC-D:7342 petitioners.
The Tahasildar thereafter forwarded a communication to respondent No.5 informing to prepare the proposal for acquisition and to send it to respondent No.6.

In all 18 acres, 32 guntas, 09 annas of land has been utilized for formation of the road and thereby requested to give direction to acquire and make the payment of compensation to the respective land losers.

5. Pursuant to the above said development, respondent No.3 has forwarded two more communications for purpose of purchasing directly from petitioners/owners of the land, a portion of the land is utilized for formation of the road.

Therefore, it is apparently clear and there is no dispute that the lands belonging to the petitioners have been utilized for formation of the road and admittedly no acquisition proceedings have taken place even according to the learned HCGP.
Though the communication has been forwarded to put forth the proposal for initiation of acquisition proceedings, nothing has moved since the initiation of the representation made by the petitioners.

It in the tug of war between the petitioners and the respondents and the petitioners having - 10 - NC: 2024:KHC-D:7342 lost their valuable land, not having provided the compensation award amount, the petitioners are put into severe loss, difficulty and financial constraint.
Neither the property is acquired nor it is purchased nor the compensation is paid.

Hence, they are before this Court for a direction to the respondents to acquire the property in accordance with law, pass an award and dispense the compensation in favour of the petitioners in accordance to the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Dttatreya S/O Devaji Patil vs State Of Karnataka on 3 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36277304/
7 6.

It is a fundamental rule of law and a constitutional right of the petitioners to use their land and enjoy the land as per Article 300 A of the Constitution of India, the State being the 'parens patriae' is the guardian of the citizens.

It cannot take away the lands of the citizen without paying the due compensation in accordance with law and having utilized and taken possession of the land, the State also cannot keep quiet without dispensing the award of compensation amount.
The State is duty bound to initiate - 11 - NC: 2024:KHC-D:7342 acquisition proceedings if the land of the petitioners are utilized.
7. In the present case, there is no dispute that the lands of the petitioners are utilized for formation of the road.

Under the circumstances, there is nothing further required to probe for the State except for awarding of suitable and reasonable compensation based on the said rules, regulation and the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Apex Court for acquisition of land based on the potentiality of the land, proximity of the land to the nearest National Highway or the State Highway and pass an award in accordance with law.

It is not only the duty of the State, but it is a constitutional right of the petitioners and so also a statutory right for which they are entitled to, which is deprived, despite the land of the petitioners being utilized and taken possession long back i.e., 20 to 25 years back.
Therefore, the arguments put forth by the petitioners merit consideration and has force.

Accordingly I proceed to pass the following:
- 12 -  NC: 2024:KHC-D:7342  ORDER  i) The writ petition is allowed.

ii) The writ of mandamus is issued to the respondent No.7 with a direction to initiate acquisition proceedings as per Annexure-ZH bearing No.LAQ:CR:27:2022-23 dated 09.05.2023 and acquire the land of the petitioners which is the subject land utilized by the State for formation of the road and consequently pay the compensation amount to the petitioners in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013, along with all statutory benefits and interest and other benefits as provided under the Act.

opennyai_summary.facts:
2. This petition is filed by the landlosers seeking for a writ of mandamus for a direction to respondent No.7 to initiate the acquisition proceedings consequently acquire the land in accordance with law for having already taken the land and utilized the land of the petitioners, pay the compensation to the petitioners as per the provisions of right to fair compensation and transparency in land acquisition, rehabilitation and resettlement Act of 2013 or in the alternative to pay the rent for damages for having utilized the land of the petitioners without acquisition.
Neither the property is acquired nor it is purchased nor the compensation is paid.
Hence, they are before this Court for a direction to the respondents to acquire the property in accordance with law, pass an award and dispense the compensation in favour of the petitioners in accordance to the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
It is a fundamental rule of law and a constitutional right of the petitioners to use their land and enjoy the land as per Article 300 A of the Constitution of India, the State being the 'parens patriae' is the guardian of the citizens.
It cannot take away the lands of the citizen without paying the due compensation in accordance with law and having utilized and taken possession of the land, the State also cannot keep quiet without dispensing the award of compensation amount.
The State is duty bound to initiate - 11 - NC: 2024:KHC-D:7342 acquisition proceedings if the land of the petitioners are utilized.
7. In the present case, there is no dispute that the lands of the petitioners are utilized for formation of the road.
Under the circumstances, there is nothing further required to probe for the State except for awarding of suitable and reasonable compensation based on the said rules, regulation and the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Apex Court for acquisition of land based on the potentiality of the land, proximity of the land to the nearest National Highway or the State Highway and pass an award in accordance with law.
It is not only the duty of the State, but it is a constitutional right of the petitioners and so also a statutory right for which they are entitled to, which is deprived, despite the land of the petitioners being utilized and taken possession long back i.e., 20 to 25 years back.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Therefore, the arguments put forth by the petitioners merit consideration and has force.
ii) The writ of mandamus is issued to the respondent No.7 with a direction to initiate acquisition proceedings as per Annexure-ZH bearing No.LAQ:CR:27:2022-23 dated 09.05.2023 and acquire the land of the petitioners which is the subject land utilized by the State for formation of the road and consequently pay the compensation amount to the petitioners in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013, along with all statutory benefits and interest and other benefits as provided under the Act.
Process of acquisition, passing of the award and release of the amount shall be done within an outer limit of six months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
